title: Interface of normalized scalar and pullback comparisons
statement: Fix small ringed sites, a ringed geometric pullback with an algebraic inverse-image presentation, and a compatible square of algebra coefficients. Use module sheaves, unbounded derived categories and the published tensor comparison. Define coefficient modules, scalar tensor presentations, exactness records, normalized units and two-resolving-factor tensor formulas, normalized scalar association, and the Coherence and Result records with their actual coefficient-map naturality equations. These are exactly the existing declarations of the parent node, relocated without changes of signatures or bodies.
